description: Generate the legal documents (privacy policy, terms of service and, if applicable, an AI disclosure) localized and tailored to the target markets (GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA…). Returns Markdown drafts. Pass check_website's or check_store's suggestedAnswers as `answers` so the documents disclose the right processing. Anonymous remote generation is template-based and capped at 3 locales; AI-tailored, hosted and auto-updated documents require a LexVibe account (https://golexvibe.com).

answers.description: Compliance flags; pass check_website's suggestedAnswers. Recognized keys: usesAnalytics, processesPayments, usesGenerativeAI, collectsEmails, sharesWithThirdParties, platformType.

appName.description: Public / commercial name of the product.

contactEmail.description: Contact email for privacy requests and data-subject rights.

entity.description: Data controller / legal entity responsible for the app.

locales.description: Document languages (max 3 for anonymous callers). Defaults to the languages suggested by the chosen markets.

markets.description: Regions where the app has users; determines the legal frameworks covered.

name: generate_policies
title: Generate legal documents
